verdict.rationale: Rive documents an automatic Revision History that tracks all changes, even from multiple collaborators on the same file. Users can preview any revision and restore it non-destructively with 'Edit Current Revision', which copies that revision to the top of the list. The evidence does not show naming milestones or comparing revisions beyond previewing them, so the story is only about half covered. Missing for 10: named milestones/versions, side-by-side comparison or diff of revisions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, full version history lets me name milestones, compare, and restore any earlier state of a file

citations.quote: Rive tracks all changes and stores them in the Revision History
Select a revision to preview it and press the Edit Current Revision button. This copies the selected revision and creates a new entry at the top of the list.
This guarantees that even restoring revisions is non-destructive, and you can always go back to the previous version of the file.
